summary: Practise EVCA, community action planning and accessible warning arrangements. Explore the five-day course and build usable local DRR outputs.
lede: Community-level disaster risk reduction (DRR) training helps turn residents’ knowledge into risk findings and agreed preparedness actions. It is for community DRR officers, resilience facilitators and preparedness officers who coordinate with residents and local organisations. Participants practise inclusive assessments using interviews, mapping and seasonal calendars, then rank risks, assign action responsibilities, plan accessible warnings and evacuation arrangements, and create records for monitoring and review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for practitioners who facilitate community assessments, preparedness work and follow-up with residents and local organisations.
audience: Early Warning and Community Engagement Officers
modules: EVCA Mapping of Hazards and Capacity
Early Warnings for All Review and Reporting
prerequisites: Prior experience in community engagement, disaster preparedness, community assessment or facilitation is expected. No coding or specialist software is required.
